properties.name: Seam roll-up finds a container by level, not by id prefix
properties.rationale:
Ten of this design's eighteen subsystems are named `sub:*`, so 58 of 86 modules never lifted and their pairs were dropped from BOTH the coupling and contract sets. seam_coverage therefore answered `0 uncovered` at subsystem altitude — a FALSE ZERO, the shape fact:ten-components-report-a-zero-blast-radius-the-source-contradicts already names as the worst answer a coupling model can give. The honest reading is 13 of 19 covered, with six named subsystem boundaries owing a contract; and the `seams 18%` trajectory band was the same defect seen from module level.

THE CLASS, recorded one day earlier on fact:which-properties-are-node-references-is-a-judgement-made-once-and-never-recorded-for-the-others: an id's spelling treated as authoritative about what a node IS, instead of asking the graph. That fact found ids CONSTRUCTED by convention; this is ids INTERPRETED by convention. The guard is that an id prefix is a naming convention carrying no meaning a computation may read — `level`, `node_type` and the schema are where that meaning is declared.

WHY NO TEST CAUGHT IT: all five existing seam_coverage tests named their fixture containers `sys:a`/`sys:b`, so the suite shared the implementation's assumption and stayed green. High coverage of the function, zero coverage of the question. Full analysis on fact:seam-roll-up-found-a-container-by-id-prefix-and-answered-a-false-zero.
properties.subject: system
properties.summary: `DesignGraph::lift_to_level` in crates/reflow2-core/src/maturity.rs chose a containment parent with `p.starts_with("cmp:") || p.starts_with("sys:")` — an id naming convention standing in for the `level` declaration. Replaced with a test that the parent IS a Component, and made the choice deterministic (smallest id) where containment forks. Also corrected `SeamSets.unreachable`'s scope_note, which counted PAIRS across both sets while calling them "endpoint(s)". Two regression tests added and OBSERVED FAILING against the unfixed code: `a_container_is_found_by_its_level_not_by_how_its_id_is_spelled` and `a_dropped_pair_is_reported_as_a_pair_not_as_an_endpoint`. 508 core tests pass.
